views.name: v_active_employees

properties.description: 在职员工宽表: 员工档案 + 部门名称, 仅 status=在职 (人员分析用)

views.statement: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.gender, e.birth_date, e.hire_date, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.location AS dept_location, e.job_title, e.job_level, e.employment_type, e.status, e.base_salary, e.work_city, e.education, CAST(date_part('year', current_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(date_part('year', e.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age, round((current_date - e.hire_date) / 365.25, 1) AS tenure_years FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE e.status = '在职'

views.name: v_attendance_daily

properties.description: 每日考勤宽表: 考勤 + 员工 + 部门 (出勤/加班分析用)

views.statement: SELECT a.att_id, a.emp_id, e.name AS emp_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.job_title, e.job_level, e.employment_type, a.att_date, a.status, a.work_hours, a.overtime_hours FROM attendance_records a JOIN employees e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id

views.name: v_attrition_detail

properties.description: 离职明细宽表: 离职员工 + 部门 + 离职面谈真实原因 (流失分析用)

views.statement: SELECT e.emp_id, e.name AS emp_name, e.gender, d.dept_name, e.job_level, e.job_title, e.work_city, e.hire_date, e.termination_date, e.termination_reason, e.is_voluntary, x.real_reason_category, x.satisfaction AS exit_satisfaction, x.would_recommend FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN exit_interviews x ON x.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.status = '离职'

views.name: v_headcount_vs_plan

properties.description: 编制达成宽表: 部门年度计划编制 vs 年末实际在职人数

views.statement: SELECT p.plan_year, make_date(p.plan_year, 12, 31) AS plan_year_end, d.dept_name, p.planned_headcount, p.budget_labor_cost, coalesce(a.actual_headcount, 0) AS actual_headcount FROM headcount_plan p JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT y.yr_end, e.dept_id, count(*) AS actual_headcount FROM ( SELECT DATE '2023-12-31' AS yr_end UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2024-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-12-31' ) y JOIN employees e ON e.hire_date <= y.yr_end AND (e.termination_date IS NULL OR e.termination_date > y.yr_end) GROUP BY y.yr_end, e.dept_id ) a ON a.yr_end = make_date(p.plan_year, 12, 31) AND a.dept_id = p.dept_id

views.name: v_monthly_salary

properties.description: 月度薪资宽表: 薪资发放 + 员工 + 部门 (人力成本=base_pay+overtime_pay+bonus 在查询时计算)

views.statement: SELECT s.pay_id, s.emp_id, e.name AS emp_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.job_title, e.job_level, e.employment_type, s.pay_period, s.base_pay, s.overtime_pay, s.bonus, s.social_insurance, s.income_tax, s.net_pay, s.pay_date FROM salary_payments s JOIN employees e ON s.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id

views.name: v_workforce_monthly

properties.description: 人力成本月度明细宽表: 薪资行 + 社保企业缴纳 (人效/总成本分析用, 聚合在查询时完成)

views.statement: SELECT s.pay_id, s.pay_period, s.pay_date, e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.name AS emp_name, d.dept_name, e.job_level, e.employment_type, s.base_pay, s.overtime_pay, s.bonus, i.company_total AS insurance_company FROM salary_payments s JOIN insurance_payments i ON i.emp_id = s.emp_id AND i.pay_period = s.pay_period JOIN employees e ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id

properties.description: 离职分析 cube: 离职人数/主动被动/面谈满意度, 按部门与原因维度

measures.name: voluntary_leavers
measures.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_voluntary THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

properties.description: 编制达成 cube: 计划编制 vs 年末实际在职
人力成本 cube: 月度应发/实发合计与发薪人数, 按部门/职级维度
招聘漏斗 cube: 候选人数与入职转化, 按来源/阶段维度

measures.name: hired_count
measures.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN stage = '已入职' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

properties.description: 人力总成本 cube: 基本工资/加班/奖金/社保企业缴纳分项聚合, 总成本在查询时相加
人员编制 cube: 在职人数/平均工资, 支持按部门/职级/城市等维度
